a normal abdominal X-ray never rules out malrotation/volvulus — if the child has bilious vomiting, keep going.

normal — duodenal C-loop crosses the midline, DJ junction left of the spine, level with the pylorus. Abnormal — fails to cross the midline (contrast stays on the right); DJ anywhere else; corkscrew = volvulus. Water-soluble contrast (Gastrografin) preferred over barium when perforation is possible. CT generally avoided in neonates.
